findings.quote: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES
findings.rationale: No aggregate liability cap at all, and consequential damages remain available for indemnification and confidentiality breaches, creating unbounded exposure for AP.

replacement.oldText: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY
replacement.newText: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY
replacement.comment: Add a mutual aggregate cap (greater of amounts paid/received in the prior 12 months or a fixed figure), with uncapped carve-outs limited to IP indemnity, data breach/privacy, gross negligence/willful misconduct and Kubient's payment obligations; delete the indemnification carve-out from the consequential damages waiver.

findings.quote: to the best of its knowledge the Creative placed onto Customer's platforms or websites by the Auction Platform
findings.rationale: Kubient's Creative indemnity is qualified by knowledge, leaving malvertising/infringing ads with AP; AP's own indemnity is fault-untethered ('unauthorized or inappropriate use', 'acts or omissions of Customer'); indemnity procedure lacks protections for AP.

replacement.oldText: to the best of its knowledge the Creative
replacement.comment: Delete the knowledge qualifier. Also in 10(b): delete 'or inappropriate', delete clause (v) or limit to Customer's negligence/willful misconduct, and limit (iii) to breach of express representations. In §11 add: no settlement imposing non-monetary obligations or admissions on AP without consent; AP may participate with own counsel; if Kubient fails to assume defense promptly AP may defend/settle at Kubient's cost.

findings.quote: non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license
findings.rationale: Licence is revocable at will while AP is locked in for the Initial Term; also blank defined term in §2.

replacement.oldText: without right of sublicense, revocable license
replacement.newText: without right of sublicense, license that is irrevocable during the Term except upon termination in accordance with Section 4,
replacement.comment: Make the licence irrevocable during the Term; also fix the blank defined term '(" ")'.

findings.quote: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice
findings.rationale: No termination for convenience during the one-year Initial Term; review recommends AP convenience right on 30-60 days plus termination for payment default, security/privacy incident, brand-safety failure and change of control.

replacement.oldText: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
replacement.newText: Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time, including during the Initial Term, upon thirty (30) days written notice to Kubient. Customer may also terminate immediately upon Kubient's payment default, a security or privacy incident, a brand-safety failure, or a change of control of Kubient. Kubient may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to Customer.
replacement.comment: Add Customer termination for convenience and cause-based exit rights.

findings.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
findings.rationale: Auto-renewal with a 90-day notice window that cannot be exercised during the Initial Term; needs calendaring/shortening.

findings.quote: governed in all respects by the laws of the State of Delaware ... irrevocably submits for all disputes to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of the state and federal courts located in New York, New York.
findings.rationale: §8 mandates AAA arbitration while §14(a) requires exclusive NY court jurisdiction — conflicting dispute clauses; Delaware law questionable where both parties are NY-based.

replacement.oldText: the laws of the State of Delaware
replacement.newText: the laws of the State of New York
replacement.comment: Resolve the §8 arbitration vs. §14(a) court-jurisdiction conflict; if arbitration, specify NYC seat, one arbitrator, confidentiality, and carve-out for injunctive relief and IP/confidentiality claims.

findings.quote: either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of said Party's assets ... or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction
findings.rationale: Kubient may assign freely, including to an AP competitor; no assumption/creditworthiness requirement and no change-of-control termination right.

replacement.oldText: either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser
replacement.newText: either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent (other than to a competitor of Customer, which requires Customer's prior written consent) to any affiliate or purchaser, provided the assignee assumes all obligations hereunder and has creditworthiness at least equivalent to the assignor, and Customer may terminate this Agreement upon a change of control of Kubient
replacement.comment: Add assumption, creditworthiness, competitor consent and change-of-control termination right.

findings.quote: the number of times a Creative is served to, and received by, a visitor viewing the Inventory as measured by Kubient
findings.rationale: Impressions measured solely by Kubient with no AP audit or verification rights over revenue share; review recommends AP audit rights with cost-shifting above 5% variance and GAM as source of truth.

findings.quote: the Service will perform in all material respects to industry standards
findings.rationale: Only 'reasonable efforts' and vague industry-standard performance warranty; no SLA, no uptime, and no warranty remedy (repair/re-perform/refund or termination).

replacement.oldText: the Service will perform in all material respects to industry standards;
replacement.newText: the Service will perform in all material respects in accordance with the applicable service level agreement and the documentation, and Kubient shall promptly re-perform or correct any non-conforming Service and, failing correction within thirty (30) days, Customer may terminate and receive a refund or credit for the affected period;
replacement.comment: Add SLA with uptime/latency/support credits and a termination right for repeated misses.

findings.rationale: No insurance obligations on Kubient; review recommends tech E&O/cyber with media liability, CGL and umbrella, with certificates and cancellation notice.

findings.quote: each Party will return or destroy any of the other Party's Confidential Information then in its possession.
findings.rationale: Termination provisions lack final reconciliation, pass-through of post-termination receipts, data deletion/return of AP data, and payment obligations in the survival list.

findings.quote: Kubient shall be responsible for contracting with all advertisers, agencies, media buyers, and/or sponsors ... on Customer's behalf, including Advertisers with whom Customer has existing relationships.
findings.rationale: Although §1 disclaims exclusivity, §5 channels all advertiser relationships, including AP's existing direct-sold relationships, through Kubient and purports to give it authority to bind AP.

replacement.oldText: Kubient shall be responsible for contracting with all advertisers, agencies, media buyers, and/or sponsors (collectively "Advertisers") on Customer's behalf, including Advertisers with whom Customer has existing relationships.
replacement.newText: Kubient shall contract with advertisers, agencies, media buyers, and/or sponsors (collectively "Advertisers") in its own name as principal, and shall have no authority to bind Customer or make representations on Customer's behalf. Customer's direct Advertiser relationships and direct-sold inventory are excluded from this Agreement, and Kubient shall not use Customer data or Customer-sourced relationships to monetize other publishers' inventory.
replacement.comment: Removes agency authority conflicting with §14(c) and protects AP direct-sold business.

findings.quote: Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement
findings.rationale: Review recommends clarifying AP may stop sending Requests at any time with no minimum volume commitment and limiting the fee entitlement to revenue actually generated through the platform.

findings.quote: the collection, maintenance, management and storage of visitor information (data), to the extent collected, directed by, maintained or stored by Kubient
findings.rationale: No data protection terms governing Kubient's use of AP Request/visitor data — no use restrictions, no ban on resale/enrichment or cross-publisher use, no breach notice, subprocessor controls or deletion on termination.
